children: Lisata Therapeutics closed a stock-for-stock acquisition of Marea Therapeutics and lined up a $225 million PIPE financing in Series C non-voting convertible preferred shares. The merger restructures ownership, with former Marea holders poised to own a majority post-PIPE, and is intended to expand Lisata’s pipeline and capabilities. To support the transaction, Lisata put in place voting support and 180-day lock-up agreements, and granted registration rights to both former Marea holders and PIPE investors to facilitate future liquidity.
